address.docs:
**integer**: The Modbus address of the server device.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

enabled.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to enable the courtesy response feature. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

register_last_address.docs:
**integer**: The highest Modbus register address (inclusive) up to which undefined registers are allowed to be read and will be padded with a default value. Any read request that includes undefined registers within this range will return the value specified by `register_value` instead of triggering an exception. Defaults to `65535`

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

register_value.docs:
**integer**: The 16-bit value (range: 0–65535) to return for undefined registers within the address range defined by `register_last_address`. Defaults to `0`.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

courtesy_response.docs:
Configuration block to enable the courtesy response feature when the device is acting as a Modbus server.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

modbus_id.docs:
**[ID](https://next.esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the `modbus` hub.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

address.docs:
**integer**: start address of the first register in a range

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

read_lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://next.esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: Lambda that returns the value of this register.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

value_type.docs:
datatype of the mod_bus register data. The default data type for ModBUS is a 16 bit integer in **big endian** format (network byte order, MSB first)

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

write_lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://next.esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: Lambda that sets the value of this register. A variable `x` of the appropriate type (`uint16_t`, `int32_t`, etc, see above) is provided with the value, as well as `address` containing the address of this register. You must return `true` if the operation was successful, `false` otherwise, in which case a ModBUS exception code `4` will be sent to the client.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*

registers.docs:
A list of registers that are responded to when acting as a server.

*See also: [Modbus Server](https://next.esphome.io/components/modbus_server#configuration-variables)*
